title: Colony Crystal Giftware 9in Crystal Vase - New with Box
descriptionText: This is a 9-inch crystal vase from Colony's Crystal Giftware collection, packaged in a box. The vase is designed with a boxing theme and is made of high-quality crystal. It is a part of the Colony product line, making it a perfect decorative piece for any home or office.
